title: Hexed Mirror
description: Immerse yourself in natural magic! This mod adds witchcraft based on herbalism & alchemy. Grow magical plants, brew potions in a teapot, and master broomstick flying. Become a wise witch exploring the world's mysteries!
body:
Welcome To The Hexed Mirror! Immerse yourself in a world of natural magic, where every ingredient counts and ancient rituals require preparation!

This mod invites you to become a true herbalist, alchemist, or just a witch. Explore the world in search of rare plants, brew liquors in a teapot, draw circles with chalk, and slash through the sky on a broomstick. Magic isn't just a flash of lightning, it's an art form!

![Welcome To The Hexed Mirror!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/199c1f1d067877c522cdff844025ca4e3c37a098.jpeg)

🌿 Herbalism and Wild Plants Nature is generous with its gifts if you know where to look. The mod features new plants that can be found in different biomes. To effectively collect wild plant seeds, use a sickle.

Forget about standard potions! Here, magic is brewed in a real teapot. Place it over a heat source and start experimenting.

![Herbalism and Wild Plants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0573a6ba1a94d6e2d2a3527af32f287215c84dcd.jpeg)

✨ Magic and Protection

Use chalk to draw magic circles on the ground. Regular chalk is suitable for basic symbols, while silver chalk (made from new silver ingots) unlocks more complex and powerful rituals. Full-fledged rituals will be added here in the future.

New ore and metal. Silver is a conductor of magic and an enemy of evil spirits. It can be used to craft weapons and special items... Also, some creatures may be interested in purchasing silver from you in exchange for interesting materials.

Wooden Cross. A simple yet effective amulet. Use the cross near undead creatures and they (zombies, skeletons) will be immobilized for a time. Create a protective perimeter around your home or trap your enemies!

![Magic and Protection](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85cfd69497904da377de996947c77fca0179974a.jpeg)

🧹 Broomstick Riding What's a witch without a broom? Craft your own broom and set off on a journey! Comfortable air travel. Broom customization with Wool, Iron, or Lamp. Flying over forests and mountains is a pure joy.

🧚 Environment and Atmosphere The world doesn't have to be empty. Pixies — small, carefree fairies — can now be found in forests and groves. They won't cause any harm or provide powerful buffs, but they create the right magical atmosphere. Just enjoy their flight through the sky... Unless you need their dust.

![This is just the beginning!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6e9e324108db3ffc185b8f775d97f8cf2c38244.jpeg)

This is just the beginning! In the next updates, you'll find:

Full-fledged rituals with pentagrams and possibly sacrifices. New magical plants and mushrooms. Familiars. Expanded flight system: broom upgrades, brooms with chests.

Join the exploration of natural magic and remember: power lies in herbs, and wisdom lies in knowing the recipes!
Attention, the mod is officially distributed only on Two platforms: Curseforge and Modrinth.
